fit_curve_principal_axis — FIT fit op

• データ種: keypoints → table

• 呼び出し: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fit_curve_principal_axis(points, degree: 'int' = 2, *, isotropy_ratio: 'float' = 0.95) -> 'dict' (実装を直接呼ぶなら import measure; measure.fit_curve_principal_axis(points, degree: 'int' = 2, *, isotropy_ratio: 'float' = 0.95) -> 'dict'、台帳から引くなら opsfit.get("fit_curve_principal_axis"))

使い方

斜めの曲がった縁を主軸へ回してから多項式 y'=f(x') を当てはめる。

Returns the image-plane angle_deg, centroid (row, col), polynomial coefficients in NumPy's descending-power convention, orthonormal axes (rows are local x/y axes in col,row order), local coordinates, fitted_points in the original row/col frame, and a gradient-normalised geometric rms. degree must be at least one and leave more samples than coefficients. A nearly round cloud (minor/major variance ratio at or above isotropy_ratio) is rejected because its principal direction is undefined.
